I lost $18,000 in March because one clause in my contract said "on approval".
That's it. Two words.
The client in Denver kept approving nothing for four months, and I kept doing revisions because I didn't know I could say no.
Now my contracts say payment on delivery, and I send them before I open Figma.
You don't need a lawyer for this. You need one sentence you're willing to defend.
I've sent that sentence to 41 clients since. Nobody pushed back.
